name: NM Dept. of Game & Fish / Wildlife calendar (archery + NASP events)
organization: New Mexico Department of Game and Fish (NMDOW)
terms: State government site; public information. No scraping restriction seen (unverified).
notes: WordPress 'The Events Calendar' (search results expose ?ical=1 month URLs and /event/<slug>/ pages). JSON should be at https://wildlife.dgf.nm.gov/wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events?search=archery. Lists NASP State Bullseye Championship (Rio Rancho Events Center), Catron County 3D shoot (Apache Creek), Monica Cabin 3D shoot (Magdalena), AIM 3-D Archery Challenge. Mixed with non-archery events -> filter by keyword 'archery'/'3D'. WebFetch blocked by sandbox egress, so endpoint not loaded. Best NM auto source.

name: NM state association / NMFAA
organization: New Mexico Archery Association / NM Field Archery (NFAA chapter)
notes: No own-site calendar found in search. NM USA Archery state championships (Albuquerque, Balloon Fiesta Park) only appear on usarchery.org (off-limits). NFAA chapter events appear on nfaausa.com (see multi-state NFAA entry).

name: Ben Avery Shooting Facility archery events (AZGFD)
terms: State government site; no restriction seen (unverified).
notes: The Events Calendar (tribe) - category 'basf-archery' ICS URL appears in search index; JSON likely at https://www.azgfd.com/wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events?categories=basf-archery. Ben Avery (Phoenix) hosts the big AZ shoots: Full Draw Bowhunters KOTD Desert Classic, ABFAA Sonoran Desert Trail Shoot, 3D80 Money & Fun Shoots, AZ USA Archery Indoor/Outdoor state champs, plus weekly Thursday-night indoor 3D fun shoots (recurring - may want to filter out). All at one venue (Phoenix). Best AZ auto source.

name: Be Outdoors Arizona - archery event category
notes: The Events Calendar with an 'archery' category (URL pattern /events/category/archery/day/... in index). Statewide outdoor-recreation aggregator; includes Arizona Bowhunters Association items. Volume/currency unknown - check before building. JSON: /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events?categories=archery.

name: ABFAA / Full Draw Bowhunters
organization: Arizona Bowhunters & Field Archers Association (NFAA chapter); Full Draw Bowhunters (Phoenix club)
terms: Events hosted on NFAA's 93ft platform - check NFAA terms (same vendor as USA Archery).
notes: ABFAA state field tournament posts on nfaausa.com event pages (Tucson Mountain Park). No standalone ABFAA calendar found. Full Draw Bowhunters' 2026 schedule seen only via third-party listings. Most of their shoots already appear in the AZGFD Ben Avery feed.

name: Total Archery Challenge - Durango
notes: 2026 tour stop Durango CO July 10-12. One event per state; see multi-state TAC entry.

name: Colorado Parks & Wildlife calendar
notes: Agency calendar (calid= pages) includes occasional archery/bowhunter-prep events; few real tournaments. Low value. Colorado State Archery Association and Colorado Bowhunters Association own-site calendars not found via search; CSAA events (Colorado Springs indoor, Canon City 3D buckle series) appear only on usarchery.org (off-limits). Colorado: no reliable auto-updating tournament source found besides TAC.

name: Total Archery Challenge - Brian Head
notes: 2026 stop Brian Head UT July 16-19 (TAC originated at Snowbasin UT).

name: Utah Bowmen's Association shoot schedule
notes: Domain blocked by sandbox egress and not surfaced in search, so format is unknown. Utah 3D season is large (state 3D, many club shoots), so this is worth a manual look from an unrestricted network to check for a Google Calendar embed. Utah DWR events page (wildlife.utah.gov/events.html, lee-kay-events.html) is agency-only and has almost no tournaments.

name: NFAA Southwest section - Nevada page
organization: National Field Archery Association (Nevada chapter events)
terms: NFAA site is built on 93ft (same vendor as USA Archery); read NFAA terms before scraping.
notes: Lists Nevada NFAA events with addresses (Las Vegas, Reno; Southwest Indoor Sectionals; The Vegas Shoot Mar 26-29 2026, a national event). No Nevada state-association site or Nevada Bowhunters calendar found. Clark County / NV State Parks only list leagues and classes.

name: Bowhunters of Wyoming 3D Shoots
notes: Statewide bowhunter association's 3D shoot page, referenced in Bighorn Mountain 3D Shoot (Sheridan) ticket page on Zeffy. The CamelCase path suggests Wild Apricot; if so, a public /events list with per-event iCal may exist. Not loaded (egress block). Zeffy ticket pages for individual shoots are also an option but are per-event.

name: Montana Bowhunters Association shoot list
notes: Forum posts say MBA keeps the statewide list of MT 3D shoots (shoots most weekends Apr-Aug). MBA Bridger 3D Shoot May 30-31 2026 near Bozeman. Format unknown. TAC Red Lodge MT June 26-28 2026 is the other big event. Montana 4-H shooting sports page (montana.edu) is a static HTML list of youth archery events.

name: Idaho State Bowhunters shoot calendar (by region)
notes: Search snippets show an ISB Region 1 2026 list with dates and towns (Farragut, Weiser, Worley, Viola, Sandpoint, Kellogg, Moyie Springs, Harrison), about 11 shoots, with other regions presumably similar. Official site URL not surfaced (domain not confirmed). Likely a hand-maintained HTML list that is updated once a year: scrapeable but brittle. IDFG press releases cover a few agency 3D shoots (St. Anthony).

name: WSAA calendars
organization: Washington State Archery Association (NFAA chapter + USA Archery state assoc.)
notes: Washington hunting forums consistently point to washingtonarchery.org/calendars as THE statewide shoot calendar (3D, field, target). A 'calendars' (plural) page often means embedded Google Calendars. If so, pulling the calendar ids gives ICS feeds, which would make this one of the strongest sources in the region. Needs a check from an unrestricted network (egress blocked here).

name: Oregon Bowhunters (OBH) shoot calendar
notes: Statewide club federation that runs the OBH State 3D and club shoot circuit. Site not surfaced in search; format unknown. ODFW workshops/events (myodfw.com, Drupal) list a few agency 3D shoots (La Pine Three Rivers Archers warm-up, Denman WA). nasptournaments.org lists Oregon NASP events. No confirmed reliable feed.

name: NFAA Southwest section - California page (CBH/SAA and club events)
organization: NFAA / California Bowmen Hunters-State Archery Association
terms: NFAA on 93ft platform: check terms (USA Archery's 93ft site bans scraping; NFAA's may too).
notes: Lists CA NFAA-sanctioned events with addresses (for example Keene CA; BTB & NFAA 1-Arrow 3D Nationals in Friant Apr 18-19 2026; Western Classic / Marked 3D Nationals in Redding May 1-3 2026). The CBH/SAA site (cbhsaa.org) is blocked here and its format is unknown. Search shows CBH state events posted mainly via clubs.

name: San Diego Archers events (CBH/SAA State 900 etc.)
notes: WordPress club site; 'keyevents' category posts include CBH/SAA State Target Championship 900 Round (Morley Field, Sept 20 2026). The RSS feed is posts, not structured events, so dates have to be parsed from titles. Single club with few events: low priority.

name: Western Classic Trail Shoot (Redding)
notes: Annual (May 1-3 2026, Redding). Single marquee event: easier to add as a yearly fact than to scrape.

name: Alaska State Archery Association
notes: Search shows ASAA announces via its website and Facebook, but no site URL or calendar surfaced. Only a few events per year, mostly Anchorage. Nothing reliable found.

name: Aloha State Archery Association
notes: Contact is a gmail address and announcements appear in Star-Advertiser and Hawaii Tribune-Herald scoreboards. Bushwhackers (Kapolei) and Hawaii Island Archery Club have no calendar found. Nothing reliable found.

name: NFAA event pages (all state chapters)
terms: Same 93ft platform as usarchery.org (whose terms ban scraping). Read nfaausa.com terms or ask NFAA for permission before building.
notes: Most NFAA state-chapter championships across the West (CBH CA, ABFAA AZ, Nevada, Utah Bowmen, WSAA etc.) get event pages at nfaausa.com/events/event-information/<id> and section/state pages like /sections/southwest/<state>. One parser could cover many states, so this is potentially the highest-leverage source, but it is gated on terms.

name: Total Archery Challenge tour
notes: 2026 has 13 stops, 3 of them in this region: Red Lodge MT (Jun 26-28), Durango CO (Jul 10-12), Brian Head UT (Jul 16-19). Others are in IN, OK, TX, TN, VT, PA, MI, SD. One schedule page, updated yearly. Platform not verified.

name: NASP tournament listings
organization: National Archery in the Schools Program
terms: Check NASP terms; site requires login for registration but tournament details pages are public (TournamentDetail.aspx?tid=...).
notes: ASP.NET site listing NASP tournaments by state (for example the 2026 Oregon-Davis Spring 3D Shootout, Western Nationals in Sandy UT, NM NASP State in Rio Rancho). Covers every state, so it's a good gap-filler for AK/HI/NV youth events. Paging and filtering may need form posts (viewstate): moderate effort.
